append.label: NO cache signal: uncached == prompt_tokens by construction; reported as append cost lower bound under the latency-only fallback

cache_signal.finding: usage.prompt_tokens_details is ABSENT on every response: this vLLM build was launched without --enable-prompt-tokens-details, so cached_tokens is not reported at all

engine_counters.caveat: engine counters are shared with the other team's traffic; a delta of X is attributed to our 3 requests only because it recurs with the same value on every independent run, while the responses themselves stay silent

fanout.verdict: unmeasurable: prefix not resident across requests on this endpoint

grid.not_measurable_note: the grid is NOT unmeasurable in principle -- the engine DOES hit (counters move by a constant 1056 tokens per repeat) -- it is unmeasurable through the response body, and the counter delta only yields the block size, not a per-L curve
grid.reason: prompt_tokens_details absent from every response; the per-request cache signal this grid needs is not exposed by this build

latency_only.latency_only_conclusion: repeat/fresh wall ratio [0.693, 0.6] across 2 probe run(s): a repeat prompt returns faster than the cold send, but never beyond roughly a third. The wall-clock speedup is real; it is reported as a LATENCY observation only, never as a cache-hit ratio, because the response field that would carry that ratio omits cached_tokens.
latency_only.note: wall-clock TTFT against a from-scratch prompt of the same length. This is a LATENCY observation, never a cache-hit ratio.
